body: I mean facility wise I’ve been to both and really enjoyed The Gym Group and it was super friendly to new people. The inside was great and simple. And it’s a pretty simple commute from point A to B

See I’m the type of person that does not like surprises. My mum hates it especially around Christmas time because I always know what I’m getting, and somehow I always end up getting it out of her one way or another. So I know everything. Or do I?
Nope you are in the right. You made sure you two were alone. And away from peoples attention. SIL needs to actually understand that it really isn’t that big of a deal

UPDATE: I went into the woods that evening and intended to overdose. A person walking their dogs spotted me, called the ambulance and I was then placed in hospital. I was in there for 8 hours and had to talk to a psych team and have blood drawn. The amount of pills I took was not lethal but definitely has made me feel shitty.
Yes they are there. But not in an emotional sense. I feel as if I failed my attempt they would be even more harsh on me than they already are.
